# SmartObjects

27 tools. Back to the [index](README.md).

## `add_smart_object_definition_default_behavior`

*Additive.*

Attach a definition-level default behavior (applied to slots without their own) to a USmartObjectDefinition; the private DefaultBehaviorDefinitions array is reached via FArrayProperty reflection.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset |
| `behavior_class` | string | yes | Behavior class: short native name or /Script path; must derive from USmartObjectBehaviorDefinition |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, behavior_class: string, default_behavior_count: int, added: bool, saved: bool }`

## `add_smart_object_slot`

*Additive, idempotent.*

Append a named activity slot to a USmartObjectDefinition (idempotent on name).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset |
| `slot_name` | string | yes | Unique name for the new slot |
| `activity_tag` | string | no | Optional FGameplayTag to attach to the slot; defaults to "Default" |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, slot_name: string, activity_tag: string, slot_count: int, added?: bool, already_existed?: bool, saved: bool }`

## `add_smart_object_slot_behavior_definition`

*Additive.*

Attach a behavior definition (class resolved by name) to a slot of a USmartObjectDefinition. The class must derive from USmartObjectBehaviorDefinition (e.g. GameplayBehaviorSmartObjectBehaviorDefinition). A behavior on every slot (or a default) makes the definition Validate()-valid.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset |
| `behavior_class` | string | yes | Behavior class: short native name (e.g. "GameplayBehaviorSmartObjectBehaviorDefinition") or full /Script path |
| `slot_index` | number | no | Index of the slot to attach the behavior to |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, slot_index: int, behavior_class: string, behavior_count: int, saved: bool }`

## `add_smart_object_slot_entrance_annotation`

*Additive.*

Add an entrance (entry/exit point) annotation to a slot of a USmartObjectDefinition, including its navigation/trajectory fields.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset |
| `slot_index` | number | no | Index of the slot to add the entrance to |
| `offset` | array | no | Optional [x, y, z] local-space offset of the entrance |
| `rotation` | array | no | Optional [pitch, yaw, roll] local-space rotation (degrees) |
| `is_entry` | boolean | no | Optional: entrance can be used to enter the slot (default true) |
| `is_exit` | boolean | no | Optional: entrance can be used to exit the slot (default true) |
| `tags` | array | no | Optional gameplay tag names identifying the entrance |
| `trace_ground_location` | boolean | no | Optional: adjust ground location with a line trace (default true). |

| `trajectory_slot_height_offset` | number | no | Optional height offset at the slot for the transition check (default 40). |

## `create_smart_object_definition`

*Additive, idempotent.*

Create a USmartObjectDefinition asset at package_path/definition_name, or load the one already there, add default slots (enabled, no tags) until it has num_activity_slots, then save it. Slots already there are kept and never taken away, so a smaller count adds nothing and a repeat call is idempotent; created says whether the asset is new. A name taken by another asset class, or a path that is not an asset path, is an error; a failed save, as during PIE, makes success false with saved=false. No undo step is recorded. Named slots: add_smart_object_slot; slot fields: set_smart_object_slot_activity_tags or set_smart_object_slot_enabled; a behavior, which register_smart_object_actor needs: add_smart_object_definition_default_behavior or add_smart_object_slot_behavior_definition; read back: get_smart_object_definition_summary.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_name` | string | yes | Name for the new Smart Object definition, also its asset name |
| `package_path` | string | no | Content folder; defaults to /Game/MCP |
| `num_activity_slots` | number | no | Slot count to reach, default 1: slots are added until the definition has this many, none are taken away |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, definition_name: string, num_slots: int, created: bool, saved: bool }`

## `find_smart_objects`

*Read-only.*

Spatially query the SmartObject subsystem for slots within a box centered on a point (USmartObjectSubsystem::FindSmartObjects). HONEST GATE: the spatial index only populates once the subsystem runtime is initialized (BeginPlay/PIE); in the editor/headless world it is empty, so this returns success with an empty results list and a note rather than fabricating hits.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `center` | array | yes | [x, y, z] world-space center of the search box |
| `radius` | number | yes | Half-extent (uu) of the AABB search box around center |
| `include_claimed` | boolean | no | Optional: also return already-claimed slots (default false) |
| `include_disabled` | boolean | no | Optional: also return disabled slots (default false) |

**Returns:** `{ center: [number, number, number], radius: number, results: [{ object_handle: string, slot_handle: string, actor_label: string }], count: int, note?: string }`

## `get_smart_object_definition_summary`

*Read-only.*

Read the object-level state of a USmartObjectDefinition asset without changing it: its activity tags with their merging policy, the user-tag filtering policy and whether the object-level user filter is empty, the slot count, the default behavior count, and bounds around every slot in the object local space (slot offsets plus the default slot size, not world space). It also runs the engine Validate() pass: is_valid, and validation_errors with the messages of every severity. A missing definition_path, or one that does not load, is an error. Per-slot fields: get_smart_object_slots_detail; slot and registered-actor counts: get_smart_object_info; entrances: get_smart_object_slot_entrance_annotations; edit the object level with set_smart_object_definition_activity_tags or set_smart_object_definition_user_tag_filter.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Object path of the USmartObjectDefinition asset, e.g. /Game/AI/SO_Bench.SO_Bench |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, slot_count: int, activity_tags: [string], merging_policy: string, filtering_policy: string, user_filter_is_empty: bool, bounds: { min: [number, number, number], max: [number, number, number] }, is_valid: bool, validation_errors: [string], default_behavior_count: int }`

## `register_smart_object_actor`

*Additive.*

Spawn an empty actor in the editor world, attach a USmartObjectComponent pointing at the given definition, and register it with USmartObjectSubsystem. Note: the definition must already have a behavior definition (per-slot or default) or the subsystem silently rejects the handle (see handle_valid).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_label` | string | yes | Editor label for the new actor |
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset |
| `location` | array | no | Optional [x, y, z] world location; defaults to (0,0,0) |

**Returns:** `{ actor_label: string, actor_name: string, definition_path: string, has_component: bool, registered: bool, handle_valid: bool }`

## `release_smart_object`

*Destructive.*

Release a Smart Object claim. The only headless-safe path is to pass actor_label so the subsystem can unregister the component (which releases any claim it holds). FSmartObjectUserHandle is private in UE 5.7, so a claim_handle-only path is not possible without a C++ extension.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_label` | string | no | Optional editor label of the actor whose component to unregister (releases all its claims) |
| `claim_handle` | string | no | Optional canonical claim string; documented limitation: round-trip is not public in 5.7 |

**Returns:** `{ actor_label: string, released: bool } | (error: "release_smart_object: ...")`

## `remove_smart_object_slot`

*Destructive.*

Remove the slot at slot_index from a USmartObjectDefinition asset, together with its behaviors, tags and annotations; later slots shift down one index, so re-read indices with get_smart_object_slots_detail. Saves the asset; a failed save returns an error with the removal kept in memory. An invalid slot_index is an error. Undoable (one editor transaction). To turn a slot off while keeping indices stable use set_smart_object_slot_enabled; add_smart_object_slot appends one.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset |
| `slot_index` | number | no | Index of the slot to remove |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, slot_index: int, slot_count: int, removed: bool, saved: bool }`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Remove an entrance annotation (by its index among the slot's entrance annotations) from a slot of a USmartObjectDefinition. entrance_index counts only FSmartObjectSlotEntranceAnnotation entries in the slot's DefinitionData (mirror of add_smart_object_slot_entrance_annotation, inverted). Idempotent: an entrance_index past the number of entrances returns already_absent without error.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset |
| `slot_index` | number | no | Index of the slot to edit |
| `entrance_index` | number | no | Index among the slot's entrance annotations to remove (0-based; entrances only, not all definition data) |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, slot_index: int, entrance_index: int, entrance_count: int, data_count: int, removed: bool, already_absent: bool, saved: bool }`

## `set_smart_object_definition_activity_tags`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Replace the object-level activity tags of a USmartObjectDefinition asset with activity_tags, optionally set its activity-tag merging policy and user-tag filtering policy, in one undo step, then save it. The whole tag container is written: an omitted or empty list empties it, and names that are not registered gameplay tags are skipped silently (compare activity_tags in the reply); an omitted policy keeps its value. A missing definition or an unknown policy name is an error checked before anything is written, so the definition stays as it was. A call that leaves tags and policies as they were changes and saves nothing (changed false), and a failed save, as during PIE, makes success false. Per-slot tags: set_smart_object_slot_activity_tags; object-level user filter: set_smart_object_definition_user_tag_filter; read back: get_smart_object_definition_summary.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset |
| `activity_tags` | array | no | Gameplay tag names for the definition's object-level activity tags; the list replaces the current tags whole |
| `merging_policy` | string | no | Optional activity-tag merging policy: "Combine" (default) or "Override"; Combine merges slot and object tags, Override lets non-empty slot tags take their place; omitted keeps the current policy |
| `filtering_policy` | string | no | Optional user-tag filtering policy: "NoFilter", "Combine", or "Override"; how the object and slot user filters apply to a request; omitted keeps the current policy |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, activity_tags: [string], merging_policy: string, filtering_policy: string, changed: bool, saved: bool, note?: string }`

## `set_smart_object_definition_user_tag_filter`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Replace the object-level user tag filter of a USmartObjectDefinition asset (the gameplay tag query a user must pass to use the object) with one built from user_tags and match (any, all or none of the tags), in one undo step, then save it. Unregistered tag names are skipped (the reply lists the tags kept); a list of only such names, or any other match, is an error before anything changes. An empty or omitted user_tags clears the filter (cleared true): an empty filter refuses no user. A call that leaves the filter as it was saves nothing (changed false). A missing definition is an error; a failed save, as during PIE, makes success false. How it combines with slot filters: filtering_policy of set_smart_object_definition_activity_tags; per-slot filter: set_smart_object_slot_user_tag_filter; read back: get_smart_object_definition_summary.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset |
| `user_tags` | array | no | Gameplay tag names the filter query matches against; unregistered names are skipped, and an empty list clears the filter |
| `match` | string | no | Match mode: "any" (default), "all", or "none"; any other value is an error |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, user_tags: [string], match: string, filter_is_empty: bool, changed: bool, cleared: bool, saved: bool, note?: string }`

## `set_smart_object_slot_enabled`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set the authored enabled flag (bEnabled) of the slot at slot_index in a USmartObjectDefinition asset, then save it: the initial state that smart objects built from this definition start with. enabled defaults to true when omitted. An invalid slot_index is an error, and a failed save returns an error with the change kept in memory. Undoable (one editor transaction). Use remove_smart_object_slot to delete the slot instead, and get_smart_object_slots_detail to read slots back.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset |
| `slot_index` | number | no | Index of the slot to edit |
| `enabled` | boolean | no | Whether the slot is enabled |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, slot_index: int, enabled: bool, saved: bool }`

## `set_smart_object_slot_transform`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Set the local offset and/or rotation (degrees) of the slot at slot_index in a USmartObjectDefinition asset, relative to the smart object's owner, then save it. Each of offset and rotation is written only when given with 3 numbers; otherwise it keeps its value. An invalid slot_index is an error, and a failed save returns an error with the change kept in memory. Undoable (one editor transaction). Read slots back with get_smart_object_slots_detail; set_smart_object_slot_enabled and set_smart_object_slot_activity_tags edit other slot fields.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset |
| `slot_index` | number | no | Index of the slot to edit |
| `offset` | array | no | Optional [x, y, z] local offset |
| `rotation` | array | no | Optional [pitch, yaw, roll] local rotation (degrees) |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, slot_index: int, offset: [number, number, number], rotation: [number, number, number], saved: bool }`

## `set_smart_object_slot_user_tag_filter`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Replace the user tag filter of the slot at slot_index in a USmartObjectDefinition asset (the gameplay tag query a user must pass to use the slot) with one built from user_tags and match (any, all or none of the tags), in one undo step, then save it. Unregistered tag names are skipped (the reply lists the tags kept); a list of only such names, or any other match, is an error before anything changes. An empty or omitted user_tags clears the filter (cleared true): an empty filter refuses no user, though under the Override policy the object-level filter then applies. A call that leaves the filter as it was saves nothing (changed false). A missing definition or an invalid slot_index is an error; a failed save, as during PIE, makes success false. Object-level filter: set_smart_object_definition_user_tag_filter; read slots back: get_smart_object_slots_detail.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `definition_path` | string | yes | Path to the USmartObjectDefinition asset |
| `slot_index` | number | no | Zero-based index of the slot to edit (see get_smart_object_slots_detail); out of range is an error |
| `user_tags` | array | no | Gameplay tag names the filter query matches against; unregistered names are skipped, and an empty list clears the filter |
| `match` | string | no | Match mode: "any" (default), "all", or "none"; any other value is an error |

**Returns:** `{ definition_path: string, slot_index: int, user_tags: [string], match: string, filter_is_empty: bool, changed: bool, cleared: bool, saved: bool, note?: string }`

## `use_smart_object`

*Destructive, idempotent.*

Claim a free slot on an actor's SmartObject component and immediately mark it occupied (USmartObjectSubsystem::MarkSlotAsOccupied), driving a behavior definition. Single-call claim+occupy keyed by actor_label (an FSmartObjectClaimHandle cannot be rebuilt from a string, so a two-step claim_handle path is impossible). HONEST GATE: the component handle only registers once the subsystem runtime is initialized (PIE/BeginPlay); headless it is invalid and this returns a clean error. Idempotent: an already-occupied slot returns already_occupied without re-occupying.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_label` | string | yes | Editor label of the actor carrying the USmartObjectComponent |
| `behavior_class` | string | no | Optional behavior definition class (short native name or /Script path); defaults to USmartObjectBehaviorDefinition |

**Returns:** `{ actor_label: string, slot_id: string, behavior_definition: string, is_occupied: bool, already_occupied: bool, success: bool }`
